messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Much to my surprise, when i slid my hand into a buck of ice and drinks to retrieve a Pepsi, I had chosen the worst pepsi of the batch.
